callback_url.description: Callback URL that receives a POST request with the same body as the task query response whenever the task state changes.

camera_fixed.description: When true the vendor appends a fixed-camera instruction to the prompt. Not supported for reference-image tasks.

content.description: Ordered input content parts: a text prompt plus optional images, videos, audio, or a draft task id.

draft.description: When true the task runs in draft mode and only produces a 480p preview video for review.

duration.description: Output duration in whole seconds. `-1` lets the model choose within the model range. Model ranges: Seedance 2.5 [4, 30], Seedance 2.0 [4, 15], Seedance 1.0 pro [2, 12]. Mutually exclusive with `frames`; `frames` wins when both are sent.

execution_expires_after.description: Task timeout in seconds in [3600, 259200], counted from `created_at`; an unfinished task is marked `expired`.

frames.description: Output frame count, which allows fractional-second durations (frames = seconds x 24). Every integer in [29, 289] that satisfies 25 + 4n is accepted. Only Seedance 1.0 pro and 1.0 pro fast support this field; `frames` wins over `duration`.

generate_audio.description: When true the generated video carries audio synchronized with the picture.

model.description: Volcengine Ark video model id or endpoint id, for example doubao-seedance-2-5-260628.

omni_reference_task_type.description: Omni-reference task type guidance. `auto` lets the model decide; `reference` generates from reference media; `edit` requires at least one reference video, ratio `adaptive`, and duration `-1`; `extend` requires at least one reference video and ratio `adaptive`.

output_format.description: Container format of the generated video; `mov` keeps a higher color precision for post-production.

priority.description: Queue priority in [0, 9]; a higher value jumps ahead of lower-priority tasks on the same endpoint. Not supported with `service_tier=flex`.

ratio.description: Output aspect ratio; `adaptive` follows the task type and the input media.

resolution.description: Output resolution tier. The allowed tiers depend on the selected model.

return_last_frame.description: When true the poll response also carries the last frame image URL (`content.last_frame_url`).

safety_identifier.description: Stable unique identifier for the end user, at most 64 characters, used by the vendor for usage-policy detection.

seed.description: Random seed in [-1, 2147483647]; `-1` uses a random seed.

service_tier.description: Service tier: `default` online inference or `flex` offline inference at a lower price. Seedance 2.5 and 2.0 do not support `flex`.

tools.description: Tools the model may call while generating the video.

watermark.description: When true the vendor adds its AI-generated watermark to the video.
